prompted_for: Key facts under a page header (became KeyFacts: numbered cells on a measurement strip, value with unit and its source)
composition: large caps section heading above a single horizontal strip of six cells
strip sits on a ruler with tick marks above and below and a dimension line across the top
big figure centred in each cell, unit beneath, source line at the bottom
lots of empty graph-paper space below the strip
mobile view stacks the cells vertically with a small dial in each
layout_devices: measurement ruler with dense tick marks framing the cells
small circular dial / gauge icons beside figures
round bolt or pin markers at cell junctions
dimension arrow line spanning the strip
dotted vertical divider between desktop and mobile
palette: deep navy figures, labels and rules
typography: large mono-style figures with comparison symbols (≤, <)
steel-blue units set smaller beside or beneath
rendering: UI mockup with subtle drop shadow on the page panel
line_and_texture: soft drop shadow under the page panels
t2i_keywords: row of numbered cells on a measurement ruler
t2i_prompt: Flat UI mockup, no device frame, of a key-facts strip for <CONTENT>. Warm off-white page on a fine graph-paper grid, deep navy 1 px linework, steel-blue for units only. A single horizontal strip of numbered cells mounted on a measurement ruler with dense tick marks above and below and a dimension line across the top; each cell has a small mono uppercase label, a large mono figure with a comparison symbol, its unit beneath in steel blue, a small dial gauge icon and a one-line source at the bottom. Pins at the cell joints. A stacked phone version beside it. Square corners, generous empty space.
signature_idea: Key facts set as readings on a measurement ruler: each value with its unit, a dial and the method that verified it.
strengths: figures with units and sources are exactly the brand's 'give the number' voice
compact, scannable, buildable as a component
ruler frame adds character without imagery
weaknesses: dial icons all identical and decorative
graph-paper grid can read as busy behind small text
heading in heavy caps rather than light
pins and ruler on both edges add visual noise
brand_fit_why: Mono figures, navy on limestone, steel-blue units and square corners fit tightly; caps heading and graph-paper busyness weaken the calm.
